x.tweet: You've been told what job to chase, not who to become. Throughline asks you about your life for twenty minutes, then shows you four real paths with salary ranges and where each one would actually hurt.

vertical_caption: You've been asking the wrong question. Instead of "what job should I take," try talking it through. Twenty-minute conversation maps four real paths with salary bands and honest downsides for each one.
shorts_description_lead: A twenty-minute conversation that maps four career paths with salary ranges and real trade-offs. Built for anyone feeling stuck between options.

video.title: Talk Through Your Career
video.script: You know what you've never tried? Actually talking through your career options with something that listens. Throughline is a twenty-minute conversation about your life, not your resume. It asks real questions, understands the tension between what pays and what fits, then maps four specific paths forward. Each path shows you the salary range and where it would chafe. Built for people stuck between options. No resume drop, no LinkedIn templates. Just a conversation. Link in the description.
